column1: # Choose the GWAS studies to show below the coverage tracks
# This file starts empty because the relevant traits depend on the gene family
# Add a row, then run the fetch again to include the study
# source may be either of the following:
#   a GWAS Catalog accession   GCST009325, whose harmonised summary statistics are
#                              downloaded and cut to this family's windows
#   a path                     to a summary-statistics table or directory containing
#                              one file per chromosome. Text files may use tabs, commas,
#                              or spaces and may be compressed with .gz; Parquet also works
# Columns are recognized by name in any order; unrecognized columns are ignored
#   position     base_pair_location, position, pos, bp, hm_pos, chromStart   required
#   p-value      p_value, p, pval, pvalue                                    required
#   chromosome   chromosome, chrom, chr, hm_chrom, #chrom                    unless one file per chromosome
#   variant id   rsid, snp_id, variant_id, hm_rsid, snp, rs_id               optional
#   effect size  beta, beta_value, hm_beta, effect_size, b                   optional
# Chromosomes may use names such as 9 or chr9
# A chromStart column is zero-based, as in BED; every other position column is one-based
# Positions must be whole numbers; for example, 59855319 and 59855319.0 are accepted
# Scientific notation such as 5.98553e+07 is rejected because it may not identify the exact base
# The assembly must match the gene data, which uses GRCh38
# Copy the example below and replace its values
# Separate columns with tabs; blank lines and comments are ignored
study_id
